risks.title: Production identity and session lifecycle unqualified
risks.mitigation: Keep managed readiness false; require live OIDC/JWKS rotation, logout, revocation, proxy, and distributed-session drills.
risks.trigger: Before any real-user or real-tenant onboarding.

risks.title: Sandbox environment enforcement not independently proven
risks.mitigation: Keep replicas at zero until admission, runtime class, node, PID/cgroup, CNI/egress, artifact, scanner, and cleanup controls pass.

risks.title: Live model and connector behavior unqualified
risks.mitigation: Use dedicated non-production accounts to verify retention, residency, quotas, TLS, egress, pagination, billing ambiguity, rotation, and semantic quality.
risks.trigger: Before enabling each provider or connector.

risks.title: Managed backup, restore, and regional fencing unmeasured
risks.mitigation: Run isolated cross-account/key/PITR restores and regional failover with ledger hashes, generations, projection rebuild, Redis redrive, and measured RPO/RTO.

risks.title: Production SLO, capacity, soak, and paging evidence absent
risks.mitigation: Run representative topology/load/skew/soak and paging drills; establish observed baselines and rollback thresholds without extrapolating local smoke.
risks.trigger: Before production traffic or an availability objective.

risks.title: Protected-branch publish and admission evidence absent
risks.mitigation: Configure branch/ruleset requirements; execute protected-branch multi-arch signing, provenance/SBOM attestation, private mirroring, and live admission rejection.

risks.title: Production protocol federation and partner trust unqualified
risks.mitigation: Keep protocol replicas at zero; require PKI/mTLS, token brokerage, egress, rotation/revocation, partner identity, conformance, and load evidence per peer.
risks.trigger: Before activating any external MCP/A2A peer.

risks.title: Encrypted erasable storage and backup deletion incomplete
risks.mitigation: Qualify tenant keying, crypto erasure, blob deletion, legal hold, export, backup expiry, and audit reconciliation with counsel-approved retention.
risks.trigger: Before storing personal, regulated, or customer-derived content.

risks.title: Independent security and accessibility assessments absent
risks.mitigation: Commission scoped penetration and manual WCAG/browser/assistive-technology reviews; track findings to closure.

risks.title: Compliance and operational evidence is organizationally incomplete
risks.mitigation: Define scope, policies, asset/vendor inventories, training, access reviews, incident records, change approvals, evidence retention, legal basis, and independent audit.
risks.trigger: Before any compliance or certification statement.

risks.title: Image scanners disagree on upstream Python package inventory
risks.mitigation: Re-scan on database updates; expire the Grype CPython disposition on 2026-08-28; verify final runtime import metadata and compare Grype, Trivy, and upstream affected ranges.
risks.trigger: Any scanner database/base digest change or disposition expiry.
